located_observations.observation: Nursery-size specimens with distinct leaves and terracotta/porcelain pots rise diagonally toward a closer central pot and large canopy. Pot rims, soil and petioles are visible. Photos organize the text seam.

located_observations.location: middle explanation and right lower visit continuation
located_observations.observation: Full text can be deciphered, but explanation and especially access, care, invitation and URL have small bodies; they do not offer comfortable continuous SNS reading.
Canopy is the dominant pictorial mass; the title is the strongest verbal anchor, then visit group. The middle paragraph visually recedes.
Serif title has open counters and controlled stroke contrast. Body syllables show stable rectangular proportions, separated word spaces and clean flat strokes.
Central light-green leaf follows a curved petiole into clustered stems rooted in visible soil within a glazed pot; no floating attachment seen. Lower pots have coherent rims and contact shadows.

text.raster_limitation: Optical reading does not authenticate source Unicode code points.

style.checked_requirement: Photographic encounter: small pot and enveloping canopy; unequal diagonal crops and lower-left title to middle paragraph to right visit route
style.observations: Substantial plant photos and crop edges organize a pale seam. Title rises above pot row; its anchor remains adjacent but higher than intended. No manual composition or mockup.

substantive_visual.observations: Living plants at household and mature scales, real soil/pots and naturally attached foliage express selection and tending.

hangul.observations: Open serif title counters, coherent medium sans body proportions; meaningful spaces. Small text bodies at usage720 are the main reading limit.

information_relationship.observations: Title/companion -> nearby slogan and three-line paragraph -> right crop-edge market/date/hours/place -> access/care -> invitation/URL. Grouping is traceable but lower continuation is small.

function_contact.observations: Leaf, petiole and pot soil attachment visible; separate small specimens have separate pots. No hand action requested.

material_edge_finish.observations: Crisp rim and leaf edges, tactile soil and pottery, cool daylight. Soft pale blending under type smooths the seam; photos remain dominant.

residuals.limit: Body is visibly smaller than comfortable reading copy; longest line feels caption-sized.
Access, care, invitation and URL are small and weaker than upper visit details.
Title sits above the lower-left pot row rather than the intended lower seam; this is a design variance, not a client preservation violation.
